svg.title: Office saved resource observations
svg.text: t=0: ATTEMPT_STARTED.started_at_monotonic_ns = 1131007203500443 ns (same-host monotonic); one saved run
OFFICE ROUTE MISMATCH: raw resource path only; not a valid frozen-route task result.
Gaps stay gaps. CPU is interval-average core (1 core = 100%); not remote model CPU or exclusive tool cost.
Network: up to 3 complete-window non-lo interfaces ranked by rx+tx; display rule, NOT identified API egress. Never sum interfaces.
Source: series/20261017T024956Z-15-r2-office.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=core; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.

Source: series/20261017T024956Z-15-r2-office.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=MiB; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.
Disk counters: cgroup / proc, separate series (MiB/s)
Source: series/20261017T024956Z-15-r2-office.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=MiB/s; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.
Source: series/20261017T024956Z-15-r2-office.csv (source file + locator + raw monotonic endpoints); unit=MiB/s; no smoothing/interpolated missing points.
Disk/proc counters are not complete filesystem I/O. Shared netns includes background traffic and virtual-interface duplicate observations.
Directory scans may contribute CPU/I/O inside these windows. Kernel memory peak is not a current/RSS curve; scope peaks are never added.
